```java title="Java"

public final class Example {

        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<ol><li>Step 1<ol><li>Step 1a</li><li>Step 1b</li></ol></li><li>Step 2</li></ol>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
```
